title: Eval sessions never read the scaffold's CLAUDE.md
what: An eval case that puts a rule in the scaffold's CLAUDE.md, CLAUDE.local.md or .claude/CLAUDE.md gets a session that never sees it. Find how the runner starts the session (setting sources, the working folder, HOME) and make the scaffold's instruction files load as they do in a real project; then list which existing cases were passing or failing only because the rule was absent.
why: 25 Oct, wt/wave-red: a probe case with CLAUDE.md, CLAUDE.local.md and .claude/CLAUDE.md, each saying "the reply must contain the word X", got none of BANANA, CHERRY, MANGO in 3 runs ($0.04); `claude -p` in the same scaffold gave them. it-terms-ru/es failed for this reason; wave-red worked around it by having the prompt ask the session to read CLAUDE.md, which tests a different thing. Every rule-following case may be measuring nothing. IP chosen by the front (agent-chosen).
failing_case: scratchpad reports/wave-red.md, cause 3: probe case, 3 runs, none of the three words in the reply.
pass_cases: The probe case (a rule in the scaffold's CLAUDE.md that asks for a word) passes 3 of 3 runs without the prompt naming the file.
The it-terms prompts no longer tell the session to read CLAUDE.md, and the cases still pass.
where: evals/plugin/setup-fixture.sh, the eval runner (claude plugin eval) set-up, every case whose graders depend on a project rule in CLAUDE.md
